Dream 2026-11-22 linked 10 vignettes from 6 days to this record as evidence. Agree if they belong here; disagree to have a later dream drop them.

- undated · touches · "The dream cycle uses these moments to build a stable, up to date, model of reality." (Vignettes are short-term memory; dreams build the model; affirmation freezes it)
- 2026-10-23 · touches · "this work is recorded somewhere safe where it can inform future refinements" (Record the work somewhere safe (2026-10-23))
- 2026-10-23 · touches · "The process will also generally keep being refined. We may find that edges are blurry" (A standard synthetic process of iterative cross referencing (2026-10-23))
- 2026-10-25 · touches · "Let's record our learning and the problems. Integrate the learning." (Record and integrate the learning; one trade-off per stage (2026-10-25))
- 2026-10-27 · retells · "The dream cycle is part of the process of working with long and short term memory." (Navigability is semantic integrity; memory is layered and temporal; the dream cycle builds long-term memory by testing against scenarios (2026-10-27))
- 2026-10-27 · touches · "Dream time should manage this list, keeping the semantic hierarchy navigable" (srs-context should hold the active collections of knowledge, kept light and navigable by dream time (2026-10-27))
- 2026-10-30 · touches · "We record vignettes that are semantically relevant. Not just commands." (Vignette 2026-10-30: vignettes record what is semantically relevant, not commands)
- 2026-10-30 · touches · "keeps testing our data in different scenarios" (Vignette 2026-10-30: dreamtime is a standard element, short-term and long-term memory differ)
- 2026-10-30 · touches · "When they find the same storyline in different vignettes they will have stronger dreams." (Vignette 2026-10-30: dreams strengthen relationships when storylines recur)
- 2026-11-06 · touches · "the conversation from early in the year was not available to the agents to work with" (The PDF for meaning is the project's foundation: the vignettes are recent, and the early conversation was not available to the agents (2026-11-06))
